title: Client Dashboard Sprint
subtitle: Your data is in a file. The client QBR is tomorrow. Build a live interactive dashboard instead of sending another deck.
ai_tool: Any AI tool (Claude, Copilot, Cursor, Gemini)

data_files.display_name: Q4 Performance Data — Meridian Retail Group
data_files.role: Meridian Retail Group Q4 FY2024 — $42.8M revenue, 4 regions, 10 clients, pipeline data

learning_objectives: Choose the right CDN stack before writing a single prompt — the stack shapes every decision that follows
Read a data file and translate what you see into specific prompt instructions, not generic descriptions
Validate your prompt in a neutral AI tool before firing in your build tool — a checked prompt produces 80% right output on the first attempt
Iterate with precision: name the exact issue, fix only that, keep everything else intact
Deliver a self-contained HTML dashboard that opens in any browser with no install, no server, no dependencies
